test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025: Morning Practice Day 2
subject: general
question: If A @ B means A is the son of B, A # B means A is the brother of B and A * B means A is the mother of B, then what does P @ Q* R # S mean?

options.text: P is the brother of S
P is the sister of S
P is the father of S
P is the son of S

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bba7462dcbbe2b12083442c4f8d6a1aa29a0315581a5bb2e485b80baebf7229.png] 

From the given information,

 
 

 Symbol
 
 
@

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
*

 
 
 

 
 
 Meaning 

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Brother 

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
 

 

Now,

P @ Q* R # S ⇒P @ Q → P is the son of Q;

Q* R → Q is the mother of R;

R # S → R is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3adfb2fb40891602ec5843c9c7f6942893396f165100245f492d572ed70299b.png] 

Thus, **P is the brother of S**.
